info.name: Penn Courses API Documentation [Accounts] User [Accounts] User [PDP] Satisfied Rule Lists API

params.name: degree_plan_id
params.description: The ID of the degree plan to query

params.name: full_code
params.description:
The full course code (e.g., 'CIS-1200')
                                    to check against requirements

params.name: rule_id
params.description:
The ID of a specific rule to check, or '-1'
                                to automatically determine the highest priority rule

items.docs:
(GET `/api/degree/satisfied-rule-list/{degree_plan_id}/{full_code}/{rule_id}`)

Provided a degree plan and a course code, retrieve a sublist
of the degrees' rules that are satisfied by the course.
